verdict.rationale: Evidence shows llama.cpp supports diverse model types—LLMs (Qwen), multimodal/VLM (Gemma-3, Qwen3.5 VLM), and quantization across many architectures—corroborated by hands-on community reports of vision and text models running well. However, there's no explicit mention of embedding-model support or a concrete claim/count of 'hundreds' of supported architectures/MoE models. missing for 10: explicit embedding-model support evidence, MoE architecture examples, first-party documentation of the full breadth/count of supported architectures.
